text:
maria (marketing): Heads-up: planning the Adaptive Routing announcement for week of Apr 12. Need final changelog URL, docs link, and a 1-sentence benchmark for the blog.

alex (eng): changelog PR is up with the API note about `routing_policy`. Non-breaking by default. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/978

nina (docs): I'll draft the docs page. Please drop the minimal request example and the migration note for pinned models.

alex (eng): example to publish:
```
POST /v1/infer
{
  "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1",
  "routing_policy": { "type": "latency_aware", "fallback": "rwd-standard" }
}
```
Migration note: pinned `rwd-standard` keeps old behavior; set `routing_policy` to opt in.

jasper (product): Marketing wants conservative bench claims. Can we provide p95 delta and cost delta?

alex (eng): internal run: p95 130ms -> 108ms (~17%); token cost ~-12%. I'll attach raw numbers to the PR.

sam (ops): Deploy plan: 2% canary in us-west for 4h, then 25% ramp. We can schedule docs to publish at canary start.

maria (marketing): Good — marketing will schedule the blog + webinar landing page to go live at canary start. Need a one-liner for the press now.

alex (eng): draft one-liner: "Adaptive Routing cuts p95 inference latency by ~17% in typical web workloads while reducing per-token cost by ~12%."

maria (marketing): I'll polish voice. Nina, can you confirm docs URL so marketing can link?

nina (docs): Staging URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (will publish at canary start).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled job #deploy-176123 for 2026-04-11T20:00:00Z. Canary targets: us-west-2 2% for 4h.

maria (marketing): Thanks everyone. Please add :eyes: when changelog/docs PRs are merged so I can lock announce copy.

alex (eng): will ping here when merged.

jasper (product): I'll notify CS to prep early access playbook.

sam (ops): I'll open the CRM webhook task to mark early interest. OPS ticket #512.
